headline: Vandalism at Salman Muqtadir's studio and health center
summary: The Bangladesh Khilafat party has called for the removal of the Home Minister following attacks on the studio and a health center in Radda.
details: A studio belonging to content creator Salman Muqtadir and a health center in Radda were targeted in recent attacks.
The incidents have sparked political reactions, with the Bangladesh Khilafat party demanding the resignation of the Home Minister.
The party claims the Home Minister has failed to maintain law and order in the country.
The attacks resulted in significant damage to the property and equipment at the studio.
The situation remains tense as political groups call for accountability regarding the security failure.
caption:
Attacks on a content creator's studio and a health center trigger political demands for the Home Minister's resignation.

A studio belonging to content creator Salman Muqtadir and a health center in Radda were targeted in recent attacks.

The party claims the Home Minister has failed to maintain law and order in the country.

The attacks resulted in significant damage to the property and equipment at the studio.

The situation remains tense as political groups call for accountability regarding the security failure.

headline: Film ‘Roid’ selected to represent Bangladesh at Oscars
summary: Mejbaur Rahman Sumon’s film will compete in the Best International Feature Film category at the 99th Academy Awards.
details: Mejbaur Rahman Sumon’s film “Roid” has been selected as Bangladesh’s official entry for the 99th Academy Awards. It will represent the country in the Best International Feature Film category.
The announcement was formally made at a press conference held at a five-star hotel in the capital today.
A total of five films were submitted for consideration to represent Bangladesh at the Oscars this year.

The submitted films included Nurul Alam Atique’s “Manusher Bagan”, Mejbaur Rahman Sumon’s “Roid”, Redoan Rony’s “Domm”, Mohammad Tauquir Islam’s “Delupi”, and Akash Haque’s “The University of Chankharpul”.
Four films advanced to the preliminary selection, from which “Roid” was ultimately chosen as the official entry.
The film explores the timeless, primal nature of love through love and silence, reflecting on human evolution.
The movie stars Mostafizur Noor Imran and Nazifa Tushi in the two central roles.
caption:
Bangladesh has officially selected ‘Roid’ to represent the country at the 99th Academy Awards.

Mejbaur Rahman Sumon’s film “Roid” has been selected as Bangladesh’s official entry for the 99th Academy Awards. It will represent the country in the Best International Feature Film category.

The announcement was formally made at a press conference held at a five-star hotel in the capital today.

A total of five films were submitted for consideration to represent Bangladesh at the Oscars this year.

The submitted films included Nurul Alam Atique’s “Manusher Bagan”, Mejbaur Rahman Sumon’s “Roid”, Redoan Rony’s “Domm”, Mohammad Tauquir Islam’s “Delupi”, and Akash Haque’s “The University of Chankharpul”.

Four films advanced to the preliminary selection, from which “Roid” was ultimately chosen as the official entry.

The film explores the timeless, primal nature of love through love and silence, reflecting on human evolution.

The movie stars Mostafizur Noor Imran and Nazifa Tushi in the two central roles.

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV
